findings.statement: Back-off events repeat; readiness probes fail with connection refused while the container is down.
Deployment s1-app sets APP_MODE to invalid.

steps.goal: Read the logs of the previous container instance of s1-app-5468546b65-dvgq5.
expected_evidence: The last lines before the exit.

findings.statement: The previous instance logged: invalid APP_MODE "invalid"; expected readonly or standard.

steps.goal: Read the logs of the current container instance of s1-app-5468546b65-dvgq5.
expected_evidence: The lines of the starting container.

findings.statement: The current instance logs the same APP_MODE error.

plans.rationale: APP_MODE looks misconfigured; find the change that set it to invalid.

steps.goal: Read the rollout history of deployment s1-app.

findings.statement: Revision 2 changed APP_MODE from standard to invalid.

steps.goal: List the recent commits of the manifest repository.

findings.statement: The commit sets APP_MODE from standard to invalid.

assessments.reason: The container exits on an invalid APP_MODE, but the change that set it is not known yet.
missing: The commit or revision that changed APP_MODE.

assessments.reason: The commit diff and the revision diff both show APP_MODE changed from standard to invalid.

body.summary: XREJECTEDX Pod s1-app-5468546b65-dvgq5 in demo-s1 restarts because commit 9b9a6ea8a72b set APP_MODE of s1-app to invalid, which the application rejects at startup.
body.impact: Deployment s1-app has no ready pod of revision 2; the pod of revision 1 still serves.

timeline.event: Commit 9b9a6ea8a72b changed APP_MODE to invalid and revision 2 rolled out.
Container app exited with code 2 for the third time.

root_cause.statement: Commit 9b9a6ea8a72b changed APP_MODE from standard to invalid; the application accepts only readonly or standard and exits with code 2 at startup.

claims.statement: The previous container instance logged that APP_MODE "invalid" is not one of readonly or standard.
Revision 2 differs from revision 1 only in APP_MODE.
No other commit after the initial manifests changed deployment.yaml.

suggestions.action: Revert commit 9b9a6ea8a72b in the manifest repository and apply the manifests again.
After the revert, check that the new pod becomes ready.

followup_questions: Why this commit and not an earlier change?
